subject: general
question: Rows in MS-Excel are identified by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**numbers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rows in MS-Excel** are identified by **numbers**.
 
• Each row in an Excel spreadsheet is labeled with a unique number, starting from 1 at the top and increasing sequentially.
 
• These numbers help to organize and reference data within the spreadsheet, allowing users to easily locate and manipulate information.
 
• Rows run horizontally across the spreadsheet, intersecting with columns which are identified by letters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Columns in MS-Excel** are identified by letters, starting from A and continuing to Z, then AA to ZZ, and so on.
 
• Excel spreadsheets can contain up to** 1,048,576 rows and 16,384 columns** in a single worksheet.
 
• Excel is widely used for data analysis, financial modeling, and other tasks requiring organized data representation.
 
• Excel also provides various tools and functions to perform calculations, create charts, and automate repetitive tasks.
